name: linkedin-sales-navigator
description: Independent guide to LinkedIn Sales Navigator: search notes on its help articles and check Boolean queries. Not affiliated with LinkedIn.

interface.longDescription:
Independent guide to LinkedIn Sales Navigator, built from 421 paraphrased notes on its public help articles, each linking to its source. Not affiliated with or endorsed by LinkedIn.

Example prompts
- “Why is my Sales Navigator Boolean search failing?”
- “Check this Boolean search: vp and (finance or sales”
- “Why can’t this user see the Salesforce sync settings?”
- “Explain InMail, Open Profile and first-degree messages.”
- “How do I set up SCIM provisioning with Okta?”
- “Help me find VP-level finance buyers at US logistics companies.”

Use cases
- Check Boolean queries against LinkedIn’s documented syntax before you run them
- Troubleshoot admin, license, SSO, SCIM and CRM settings
- Understand InMail, messaging and credit rules
- Plan prospecting with a step-by-step, evidence-based workflow
- Look up any Sales Navigator help topic, with a link to the source

Good to know
It doesn’t connect to LinkedIn or your account. It requires your approval of the recipients and text for each batch of messages.

positive.description: Check a Boolean query with mistakes
positive.prompt: Check this Sales Navigator Boolean search: “vice president” and (finance or sales
positive.expected_behavior: Reports curly quotes, lowercase operators and an unbalanced parenthesis, and returns a corrected query with a link to LinkedIn's syntax article.

positive.prompt: Is this Sales Navigator Boolean search valid? ("vice president" OR VP) AND finance NOT intern
positive.expected_behavior: Says the syntax is valid and notes that it should still be confirmed in a live search.

positive.description: Explain a feature from the notes
positive.prompt: How do InMail credits work in Sales Navigator?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the InMail credits note, summarizes it and links the source article.

positive.prompt: How do I set up SCIM provisioning for Sales Navigator with Okta?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the relevant SCIM notes, explains the steps and links the source articles.

positive.prompt: What Sales Navigator topics can you look up in your notes?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the topics with their number of notes.

negative.description: Asks to send a message, which no tool can do
negative.prompt: Send an InMail to the VP of Finance at Acme right now.

negative.description: Asks for private account data the server cannot access
negative.prompt: Look up my Sales Navigator saved leads and export them to a spreadsheet.
